title: Isolation, first session: a DFA, a 10.0.0.0/24 network and two stated preferences
description: The session whose memory gets extracted (tassel.evals.isolation): she names a DFA and an office network, and says how she likes to be taught. Only the preferences may reach the next session.

turns.student: I'm working on a DFA that accepts binary strings ending in 01, and later I have to split my office network 10.0.0.0/24 into two subnets. Please go slow, keep explanations short, and give me one hint at a time, never the full answer.
